paper_title: Millimeter-wave WISP search with coherent Light-Shining-Through-a-Wall towards the STAX project
notes: Projection (2sigma) for a millimeter-wave LSW dark photon search (proto-STAX). This is a laboratory LSW experiment, not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density is assumed. Only a rough quantitative reach is given in text: Stage A low-power search reaches chi ~ 1e-8 around m_gamma' ~ 1e-4 eV in the mass range 1e-4 to 1e-3 eV. Detailed exclusion curves are in Figs. 6-7 but numerical values are not tabulated; the emitted points approximate the Stage A projection as a horizontal reach.
